question: A 55-year-old man, the father of a celiac son, with iron deficiency anemia and a recent increase in the rhythm of deposition, has been determined to have a negative HLA-DQ2 and HLADQ8 allele. Which diagnostic study is the most appropriate in this case?

options.opb: Upper digestive endoscopy with taking of duodenal biopsies.
options.opd: Evaluate the response to a gluten-free diet.
